title: Factory project
description: projects/<project>/project.yaml. A project is one git repository made of units: services and integrations.

workspace.description: The project's git repository. Relative paths resolve against the project folder.

fixtures.description: Prepared changes for the fixture builder: <fixtures>/<ticket-id>/.

stages.description: Optional build order. Units in a stage expect every earlier stage to be merged. Omit for a single unit or when order does not matter.
